displayName: OCI-AI-PD-004: AI — Prompt Leaking via Instruction Extraction
description:
Detects attempts to extract system instructions through social engineering or direct questioning

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — prompt leaking via instruction extraction

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_004", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%leaking%') AND "value" > 0
